body:
Decided by Karolis in chat, 31 Oct. Replaces pet decision 8 (four needs).
1. Hunger: one food fills it. Full to hungry takes about 20 minutes of play.
2. Happiness: petting, playing, toys, naps and the pet's favourite thing fill it.
3. Hungry signs: sniffs, sits by the empty bowl.
4. Unhappy signs: brings a toy, bounces, yawns, follows close, nudges.
5. Moods stay: very very happy, happy, normal, sad.
6. Old saves: happiness stays; hunger starts full.

comments.text: Decided by you in chat, 31 Oct.
Done: one food fills hunger (line 1), for Economy's food prices.
Replaced 31 Oct: no hunger, one need = happiness (you decided).

short: Pets have two needs: hunger and happiness
source: chat 31 Oct 2026: Karolis in the Game rules chat
title: Two needs: hunger and happiness
